title: Admiral Ackbar
subtitle: Rebel Alliance
franchise: Star Wars: Return of the Jedi
description: Admiral Gial Ackbar was a veteran of the Clone Wars and the Rebellion in the hours of greatest need. Commanding the battle of the Second Death Star from a Mon Calamari cruiser, he kept the Rebellion in the fight long enough for the fighters to fly into the super-structure and destroy the station. A strong leader with a distinctive voice, the Mon Calamari went on to serve with the Resistance as well.
